technical_summary: Stratified scan separates data-integrity defects, operational black-swan days, and period/product mechanics that aggregate company Z-scores miss.

layer_breakdown.L1: Sign and identity checks on stake, volume, actives; promo-compatible stake=0 netting vs true negatives.
layer_breakdown.L2: Company daily Z plus within-segment temporal Z; masked losses when company_profit > 0 and cell impact is severe.
layer_breakdown.L3: Engagement ratios vs financials to detect logging or promo engines that inflate activity without healthy margin.
layer_breakdown.L4: Period margin Z for structural regime changes.

actionable_recommendations.title: Integrity gates in dbt
actionable_recommendations.action: Fail builds on negative stake/volume; document stake=0 P&L as promo settlement, not silent error.

actionable_recommendations.title: Masked-loss monitor
actionable_recommendations.action: Daily job: company_profit > 0 and segment profit < -critical_threshold → page Risk Tech.

actionable_recommendations.title: Within-segment baselines
actionable_recommendations.action: Rolling 30-day Z per Market×Platform in the warehouse; do not use a single global threshold only.
